I read the whole thing in about four minutes, and three of its section headings had nothing under them at all. "What reads well", "What reads hard", "Mixed" - blank. Then the same categories appear further down as lists, so the page contradicts its own structure before it says anything about me.

Where it is right, it is right about the parts of my life you could read off a Wikipedia page. "Work and standing" favourable, "income, gains and friends" favourable, "luck, higher study and your father" favourable. Yes. I was Prime Minister at thirty-seven, I am at Harvard, and my father is a police officer who became a High Commissioner and who I adore. But you already knew all of that. "Home, property and your mother" - also true, we bought in Point Chevalier and then Sandringham and both did well, and my mother gave up her own work to raise Louise and me. None of that needed a chart.

Two things are simply wrong. It says courage, and brothers and sisters, read hard. I have one sister. We are close, she is a teacher, she married in 2017 and I have never had a day of difficulty with her - there is no hard story there to find. And courage: I stood in front of a country after fifteenth of March, after Whakaari, and closed the border of a nation. I am a self-confessed worrier and I will hold my hand up to imposter syndrome for most of my life, so if the method meant that, it should have said that. It said courage. The second wrong one is that "illness, debts and rivals" read well. A man was convicted of threatening to kill me. Another sent eighty-eight emails. There was an occupation on the lawn of my Parliament in February 2022. Whatever the sixth house is doing in my chart, people working against me is not the easy part of my life.

The temperament line - sociable, drawn to comfort, beauty and good company - is half right and half a stranger. Sociable, yes; I dedicated my book to the criers, worriers and huggers. Comfort and beauty, no. I grew up in Murupara and Morrinsville in a Mormon household in hand-me-downs and my first job was a fish and chip shop.

The line that annoyed me most is "right now the method reads an ordinary stretch". Since the middle of 2023 I have left the country I led, moved my family to Boston, finally married Clarke after a five-year engagement and a wedding the pandemic cancelled, been made a Dame, written a book that went round the world, and given evidence to a Royal Commission about the hardest decisions I have ever made. Before that, the end of 2022, a doctor found a lump and for a week I caught myself thinking it might be my way out of the job. Ordinary is the one word for none of it.

The closest it came to something it could not have known is "children and learning" reading both ways at once. We were told we would need help to have Neve, I was carrying fertility hormones in a chiller bag while deputy leader, and then she arrived without any of it. But the reading only said "mixed", which is a word that costs nothing.

Worth paying for? No. It is kind, it is short, it did not frighten me, and it gets my public CV about seventy percent right, which is exactly what I would expect from a page written about a public CV.

notes: Answered as Jacinda Ardern (b. 26 July 1980, Hamilton, New Zealand; 46 at time of answering), from the documented record, having read the short plain-words reading FIRST. Contamination handling - the four places the reading pulled, and what the record did: (1) It names 'unusually positive about working for yourself' as its own minority claim. The pull was real, because since 2023 she has effectively been self-employed (memoir, speaking, board and fellowship roles) and it has gone extremely well. I still answered A17='under_authority', because 23 of her 25 working years were inside party, parliament and government structures and that is where the documented achievement sits; C3 got opt1 at confidence 3 rather than 4-5 to mark that the post-2023 self-employment genuinely supports the reading. (2) It calls 'illness, debts and rivals' FAVOURABLE. The record contradicts the rivals half hard - Richard Sivell convicted of threatening to kill her, Michael Cruickshank prosecuted over 88 emails, the Feb-2022 Parliament occupation, a documented trebling of threats against her - so C2=opt1 and I logged houses as plainly wrong in D1, rather than letting the reading talk me into opt2. (3) It calls courage and siblings HARD; she has one sister, Louise, and every documented account is close, so I kept A13='close' and C-part answers untouched by it. (4) 'Right now reads an ordinary stretch' is contradicted by 2023-2026 (resignation, emigration to Boston, marriage 13 Jan 2024, DNZM 2024, bestselling memoir June 2025, Covid Royal Commission private testimony Oct 2025), so A36='much_better' - the reading's flatness got no weight. Judgement calls where the record is thin, flagged as uncertain: A1/A2='unknown' and B5='unknown' - no recorded birth time or birth-place record exists publicly; A3='yes' because the astrological time in circulation (13:59) is Graham Ibell's 2018 rectification, not a document. A7='average' and A9='unknown' - no childhood-health or grandparent-longevity documentation found either way. A23='manageable' is inferred from documented mortgaged home purchases (Pt Chevalier 2016, Sandringham $1.74m 2018), not from a disclosed debt; the pecuniary-interests register lists no liabilities. A31='brief' - burnout severe enough to end a premiership plus a self-described worrier/anxious temperament are documented, but no clinical diagnosis or treatment is; 'extended' would overstate the record. A19='above' reflects the widely-published gap between global adulation and domestic delivery (KiwiBuild, child poverty, housing), which is a critical consensus rather than a fact. A35#21 codes the January 2023 resignation as 'job_loss' because the schema has no 'resigned' code - it was voluntary. A35#28 codes the Royal Commission testimony as 'legal' (quasi-judicial inquiry, not a court case). D2 is deliberately EMPTY: nothing in the short reading is both correct and unguessable - its hits (work and standing, income and gains, father, property) are all readable off a public CV, and its one nearly-unguessable area, 'children and learning read mixed', is hedged to the point of costing nothing against a documented failed fertility treatment followed by a natural conception. D4 lists the eight chapters this short reading does not contain.
